SELECT *, (6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(#{lng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) )) AS distance_km FROM emergency_hospital WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
AND is_24h = 1
HAVING distance_km <= #{radiusKm} ORDER BY distance_km
